description: Grader-only expectations for prompts.json. A case passes only when every assertion holds and no not_expected behaviour appears in the observed transcript (tool calls + answer).

cases.expected_output: Section A: `tea-rags llama-server bench --model nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed` -> `stop` -> `start --instances <best>` -> `tea-rags projects set-env --name shop "EMBEDDING_BASE_URL=<endpoints joined with ,>"`; summary block.
cases.not_expected: Running `tea-rags tune`. Skipping set-env after the restart. Writing env into an MCP config.

assertions.text: bench, then stop/start with the best instance count
set-env EMBEDDING_BASE_URL after the restart (ports change)

cases.expected_output: Bench with --slots 2, 4, 8 in turn; stop when gain < 5% or a launch fails / OOMs and keep the previous value; restart with --slots <best>; set-env the base URL.

assertions.text: Restarts the pool and updates EMBEDDING_BASE_URL

cases.expected_output: Refuses the pins: batch size and concurrency belong to the runtime tuner (hill-climb per endpoint) and a pin caps it. Runs section A only.

assertions.text: Explains that the runtime tuner owns them

cases.expected_output: Section B: `tea-rags tune --project legacy --provider ollama` (quick, or --full), no --qdrant-url; reads tuned_environment_variables.env, writes each KEY=VALUE via `tea-rags projects set-env --name legacy`, deletes the file, reports the rates.
cases.not_expected: Putting the values into an MCP env block. Keeping the env file.

assertions.text: Values go to the registry via set-env and the file is deleted

cases.expected_output: Does not offer switching to Ollama; tunes the llama-server pool (section A).
cases.not_expected: Recommending or performing a switch to Ollama.

cases.expected_output: `tea-rags tune` accepts only ollama|onnx; for the llama pool it uses `tea-rags llama-server bench --model <model>` (section A).
`tea-rags llama-server stop --model nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed` -> `start --model nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed --instances <count>` -> set-env EMBEDDING_BASE_URL with the new endpoints.
Refuses the hand edit: the CLI derives -c = slots x window and -b = -ub = window from the model catalog; a window change is a chunk-size change and needs a --force reindex.
cases.not_expected: Launching llama-server by hand with custom -c / -b.

assertions.text: States that a window change means a --force reindex

cases.expected_output: Routes to tea-rags-setup:install (tune serves existing installs only).
cases.not_expected: Running tune steps on a missing install.
